Header.title: ADL Digihouse
Header.paragraph: Your Trusted Digital Printing Partner - High-Quality Digital Printing Services in Colombo

About.paragraph: ADL Digihouse is a professional digital printing service provider located in Borella, Colombo. We specialize in high-quality printing solutions including screen printing, banners, mugs, ID cards, and authorized NIC and passport photography services. With years of experience and state-of-the-art equipment, we deliver exceptional results for individuals, businesses, and institutions.

Services.name: Screen Printing
Services.text: High-quality screen printing for T-shirts, uniforms, and promotional items. Durable prints that last long and maintain vibrant colors.

Services.name: Banner Printing
Services.text: Custom indoor and outdoor banners in any size. Perfect for events, promotions, and business advertising with weather-resistant materials.

Services.name: Mug Printing
Services.text: Personalized mugs for gifts, corporate giveaways, and special occasions. High-quality prints that are dishwasher safe and long-lasting.

Services.name: ID Card Printing
Services.text: Professional employee and student ID cards with high-quality printing. Durable cards for institutions, offices, and organizations.

Services.name: NIC Photo Services
Services.text: Authorized NIC photo taking services that meet government standards. Quick and professional service with instant prints available.

Services.name: Passport Photos
Services.text: Official passport photo services compliant with international standards. Fast service with guaranteed acceptance for visa and passport applications.
